name: match-mate-app
description: Repository-level tooling for Match Mate API and mobile applications.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:mobile
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:api && npm run format:check:mobile
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:api && npm run test:coverage:mobile
scripts.db:audit:ci: npm --prefix match-mate-api-server run migration:validate && npm --prefix match-mate-api-server run explain:audit -- --dry-run
scripts.db:audit:staging: npm --prefix match-mate-api-server run migration:status && npm --prefix match-mate-api-server run index:audit:strict && npm --prefix match-mate-api-server run explain:audit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run contracts:check && npm run db:audit:ci && npm run build:api
scripts.ci: npm run verify && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run i18n:check
